appEligibility: Merged to main during September 2026, plus identified September-release carryovers.

items.title: September 2026 apps release notes
items.metaDescription: September connects order investigation, product calendar dates, replenishment planning, and Shopify inventory and transfer operations across HotWax Commerce.

items.title: HotWax brings Shopify inventory and transfer diagnostics into Company
items.metaDescription: Company connects Shopify inventory events, delivery timing, batch details, transfer sync health, and mapping conflicts in one operating workspace.

items.title: HotWax connects order history, item actions, and inventory transfers in Order Manager
items.metaDescription: Order Manager connects a readable order timeline with item status, scoped actions, inventory transfer requests, and staged order attribute changes.

items.title: HotWax connects product calendar dates to inventory selling windows
items.metaDescription: Map Shopify lifecycle dates in Company, review them in Products, and use scheduled date conditions in HotWax Commerce inventory rules.

items.title: HotWax brings inventory history and replenishment planning into Order Routing
items.metaDescription: Order Routing connects multi-facility inventory searches, movement history, demand, incoming stock, and editable replenishment settings.

items.title: HotWax adds inventory transfer requests with explicit execution and cancellation
items.metaDescription: Request a one-product movement between facilities, review its order context, and execute paired inventory adjustments or cancel without changing stock.

items.title: HotWax expands Shopify inventory publishing to physical locations and kits
items.metaDescription: Shopify physical-location events, available-to-promise resets, and facility-level kit calculations keep availability tied to stock retailers can fulfill.

items.title: HotWax connects transfer orders to Shopify's native transfer workflow
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce connects approved transfer orders with Shopify native transfers, linked shipments and receipts, and updates to transfer line items.
